article.title: Metro DC DSA Welcomes Councilmember-elect Oye Owolewa as a Socialist in Office
article.author: Metro DC DSA
article.content: On Friday, November 6, Metro DC DSA voted overwhelmingly to welcome Councilmember-elect Oye Owolewa as a Socialist in Office (SIO). As an SIO, Oye is able to participate in the chapter’s Socialists in Office Committee, the How We Win network of democratic socialist elected officials nationwide, and other resources of the organization. The post Metro DC DSA Welcomes Councilmember-elect Oye Owolewa as a Socialist in Office appeared first on Metro DC DSA .
